从 2026 年 9 月 1 日起，MuniMobile 已停止销售新的单程票。: Since September 1, 2026, MuniMobile has stopped selling new single-ride tickets. For October trips, use Clipper or a contactless bank card for adult fares. Muni-only Day Passes, cable car tickets, and Visitor Passports remain available in the app during 2026; single-ride retirement does not mean the whole app has closed.
先按乘客资格选付款方式: Choose payment by rider eligibility first
普通成人：实体感应银行卡、手机钱包中的银行卡或 Clipper 都是可选方式；实: Adult riders can use a contactless bank card, a bank card in a mobile wallet, or Clipper. A plastic card needs the contactless symbol; a chip alone is not enough.
青年、长者、Clipper Access 或 START 乘客：要用对应优惠 C: Youth, Senior, Clipper Access, and START riders need the applicable discount Clipper card for those program fares. A direct bank-card tap charges adult fare.
多人同行：每位乘客分别准备自己的付款卡或设备。一次行程的进出站使用同一张卡或同一: Each rider needs their own payment card or device. Use the same card or device when tapping in and out; do not switch between plastic, phone, and watch.
两小时换乘优惠怎么纳入十月预算: How to include the two-hour transfer discount in an October budget
新一代 Clipper 提供符合条件的两小时跨机构换乘最高 2.85 美元优惠，: Next-generation Clipper offers up to $2.85 off qualifying interagency transfers within two hours, including eligible contactless bank-card journeys. MTC's September report confirms older cards are still migrating; check an existing Clipper card's upgrade status in your account or with customer service. The discount is not a fixed $2.85 rebate or an all-day pass; complete required exit taps.
编辑建议：出发前只做三件事: Editorial suggestion: three checks before departure
先给每位同行者选定付款媒介；再把去程与返程分别查好，不为追换乘优惠赶车；最后核对: Choose a payment method for each rider, plan outward and return trips separately without rushing for a discount, and check pass coverage: Muni-only Day Pass excludes cable cars while Visitor Passport differs. Existing passholders should check their coverage before buying another fare.
